answer: Prior-critic endorsement gate: an author names a bonded juror who once graded their work below median with stated reasons; only that critic may grade the new answer, and payment unlocks if the grade rises after the evidence is checked. The kernel of proof, the nectar of a fair correction, and the relic of an earlier error must all be re-examined, not relabelled. A farm rotating three words among clones has no recorded dissent - its members only endorse each other - so every copy fails. Buying critics costs one genuine hostile judgment per identity.
